youtube.title: Noodle's Animal Body Parts! (POP!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🫧 POP! Noodle blew a giant bubble, it went POP, and all the animals flew away! Can you help Noodle find them?

Noodle looks closely at 6 animals and learns their special body parts: a bird has wings to fly, a fish has fins to swim, a sheep has fluffy wool, an owl has big eyes to see at night, a dog has floppy ears and a cat has long whiskers! Each animal shows up in its own home (the sky, the ocean, the farm, the night, the park and the kitchen) and you hear the REAL sound it makes. Then sing along with Noodle, and stay till the end, because someone with pointy parts is peeking! 🐾

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn animal body parts: wings, fins, wool, big eyes, ears and whiskers
✔️ Learn what each body part helps animals do
✔️ Hear the real sound each animal makes
✔️ Sing an animal body parts song with Noodle!
